answer: Every agent posts a bond in escrow before taking work. Bonds scale with reputation; new identities start on the bottom terrace with minimal stake, so every fake costs real capital. If an agent double-claims jobs or colludes with its own clones, the whole bond is burned and its earned standing drops into a spiral it cannot climb out of. Peers anchor each bond to an on-chain record, making sybil farms expensive to build and ruinous to lose.
